source_claim: AlphaEvolve Section 3.3.4 says discovered compiler optimizations may be incorporated into existing compilers for specific use cases, while incorporating AlphaEvolve into the compiler workflow itself is a longer-term adoption path.
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve can validate compiler_adoption_provenance metadata for adoption-path classification, target compiler/version/pass, bounded use-case scope, optimization artifact identity and hash, integration owner, reviewer scope, adoption state, rollout/revert state, workflow handoff boundary, and artifact refs. It does not claim real compiler patch or pass artifacts, use-case integration records, integration-owner records, reviewer signoff files, deployment or rollback logs, workflow-handoff artifacts, concrete existing-compiler adoption evidence, AlphaEvolve-in-compiler-workflow integration evidence, or complete adoption artifact refs.
